integrity_notes: The Gamma and generalized inverse Gaussian stationary density formulas are previously known. The claimed result is the sharp weak-immigration total-variation coefficients and normalized signed-deficit localization; numerical checks are corroboration, not proof.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional stochastic logistic diffusion with multiplicative Brownian noise and constant immigration; no interactions, demographic extinction, finite-time mixing, or joint variation of shape and immigration.
title: Sharp immigration susceptibility and three-scale deficit localization at a Gamma coexistence boundary
